kind: Focused E5 sufficiency review and Fossil Sovereignty consistency repair
scope: Keep each application's existing essential-record, role and version scope. Do not narrow a broad scope after the fact to obtain Pass. E3/E2/E1/E4/Locality are not re-certified; Fossil's positive Sovereignty versus unverified E2 is corrected separately.

thresholds.authorization: Risk-proportionate prior choice, including explicit commands or a deliberately configured policy; a modal prompt is not universally required.
thresholds.inspection: Meaningful source/state/operation visibility such as previews, recorded changes, diffs or accessible operation/error records. The existence of a manual is not itself such visibility.
thresholds.correction: Rollback, retained state or practical recourse where feasible; neither perpetual history nor undo of every intentionally permanent action is required.
thresholds.sufficiency: Concrete comprehensive source/control evidence may support Medium confidence with explicit inference and limitations. Do not claim application execution or assume effective settings. Missing essential control coverage stays Not Verified.
thresholds.separation: Do not use absence of E3 clean restore, numerical correctness, rendering equivalence or unknown future versions by itself to block E5.

zim-wiki: editor undo, plugin/tool and transmission authority
taskwarrior: sync transmission and operation preview/undo boundaries
calibre: library/device/format removal and permanent trash expiry
visible failures, restoration and effective policy choices
